answer_1.quote: Text simplification (TS) is a crucial task in natural language processing, with the goal of converting complex text into simpler, easier-to-understand one.

answer_2.quote: Following the criticism  on using BLEU , we use SARI  as our main evaluation metric. However, we also report BLEU for two reasons: i) to be consistent with previous works (see ) and ii) to gain more insights on how the chosen metric for MBL effects the results measured with different metrics.
